mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AYC150 ( INDEX_SN , CONSTT_ID , NTABRD_EVL_YN , CHTT_EVL_YN , INCUBA_WORK_YMD ) SELECT AYC150_SQ01.NEXTVAL , BB.CONSTT_ID , BB.NTABRD_EVL_YN , BB.CHTT_EVL_YN , TO_CHAR(AA.INCUBA_WORK_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD') FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{START_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') + (LEVEL - 1)) AS INCUBA_WORK_YMD FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(#{START_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1 ) AA , ( SELECT #{CONSTT_ID} AS CONSTT_ID , #{NTABRD_EVL_YN} AS NTABRD_EVL_YN , #{CHTT_EVL_YN} AS CHTT_EVL_YN FROM DUAL ) BB
